technical-summary: AS40 second increment. Added rpc_tap_transport.py (cross-platform duplex IPC address/listener/client on multiprocessing.connection -- AF_UNIX on POSIX, AF_PIPE on Windows -- with per-request HMAC authkey); rpc_tap_shim.py (the tee shim's core: spawns the real pi child, pumps stdin passthrough and fans stdout to both the untouched pi-acp-bound copy and a best-effort, fail-open tap sink, transport-agnostic and injectable for testing); rpc_tap_receiver.py (AG-side: opens the listener matching a launch's tap config, decodes the accepted connection's byte stream through JsonlTapDecoder). Wired build_acp_launch(..., enable_rpc_tap=True) in acp.py to install the shim at the existing PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND hook (same mechanism already used for MCP isolation) and configure a per-request tap address/authkey in the returned launch environment. 20 new/updated unit tests, including a real end-to-end chain (launch config -> real subprocess spawn -> real Windows named-pipe transport, exercised for real on this host -> decoded frames at the receiver) and byte-transparency checks (stdin/stdout passthrough exact-match, fail-open on an unreachable tap). No regressions in the wider provider suite (same 8 pre-existing unrelated failures, architecture boundary test still green). Still not built: real pi-acp + real pi byte-transparency proof, concurrent two-session non-contamination, full crash/restart cleanup matrix, AS29 capability update, AS41 evidence mapping.
user-summary-candidate: AS40 (Pi RPC observation tap): built the tee shim, cross-platform IPC transport, and AG-side receiver, wired end-to-end and tested -- including a real run over this machine's Windows named-pipe transport. The real-pi byte-transparency proof and multi-session concurrency tests are next.
